server.name: community-codecanvas
server.version: codecanvas-mcp (npm latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 641 of Frame 3, block 6. Thirteen tools, none annotated; all analyse a Python project. The analysis writes a call-graph cache to <project>/.codecanvas/callgraph.json, keyed by the source files' modification times; two clean runs differed only in that key. The cache is bookkeeping, as with other servers' indexes, and is not observed; the rest of the project is.
